regex.title: Regex Rules
regex.description: Keep records where the content of KEY matches the regular expression. Format: KEY REGEX. Supports record accessor for nested fields.

exclude.title: Exclude Rules
exclude.description: Exclude records where the content of KEY matches the regular expression. Format: KEY REGEX. Supports record accessor for nested fields.

logical_op.title: Logical Operator
logical_op.description: Logical operator for multiple rules. In legacy mode, behavior is AND for includes, OR for excludes. Cannot mix Regex and Exclude when using AND/OR.
